title: Add MemoryClaim and ContextBuilder

context.summary: Add the core memory claim and context building contracts, plus API route surfaces for manual memory remember, search, explain and context build.
context.background: TASK-9 added extraction, chunking, embeddings and vector index scaffolding. TASK-10 exposes the memory/context domain boundary while avoiding concrete persistence and vector runtime wiring.

in: Define SourceRef, MemoryClaim, MemoryRepository, MemoryService and ContextBuilder contracts in @mindory/core.
Implement manual memory remember defaults and validation in the core service.
Implement memory search and explain service methods over repository interfaces.
Implement prompt-ready context assembly over injected session, memory and document chunk repositories.
Add Fastify route surfaces for /v1/memories and /v1/context/build.
Add memory/context validation to repository checks.
Update architecture, API, memory model and README documentation.
out: Implement vector-powered memory or document search.
Implement MCP, CLI or Hermes calls to the new endpoints.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports memory claim, source reference, memory repository and context builder contracts.
Manual memory remember requires source references and defaults remembered claims to active status.
Memory search defaults to active memory claims unless statuses are provided.
Memory explain returns the memory claim source references and creation metadata.
ContextBuilder can assemble session summary, recent message, memory and document chunk blocks within a token budget.
The API app registers /v1/memories and /v1/context/build route surfaces.
Default API build returns explicit not_implemented errors until runtime dependencies are injected.
Documentation describes the current memory/context boundary.
No concrete database repository, vector search, memory derivation worker, MCP, CLI or Hermes integration is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm MemoryClaim source refs are required for manual remember.
Confirm ContextBuilder is repository-injected and not tied to concrete persistence.
Confirm no PostgreSQL repository, vector search runtime, MCP, CLI or Hermes behavior was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
Memory and context behavior is structurally validated but not exercised against a live database or vector index in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
